summary: The agent successfully completed a stochastic/datacenter resource planning task using techniques from excel-inventory-analysis. Key learnings: 1) The fixed-row assumption (rows 13-16 for control rows) from excel-financial-reconciliation is domain-specific and shouldn't be applied broadly. 2) The agent correctly used pandas initially then switched to openpyxl for precise formatting control. 3) Boolean type preservation required explicit handling with openpyxl. 4) The stochastic safety buffer calculation (Z * stddev * sqrt(days)) is a reusable pattern for probabilistic resource planning. Adding this as a variant pattern to excel-inventory-analysis with stochastic safety buffer calculations and proper boolean handling.
